questions.stem: Agents and managers cannot create knowledge articles from Community questions.
questions.explanation: Agents and managers CAN create KB articles from community questions using the Harvest Knowledge feature, which converts accepted community answers into KB articles.

questions.stem: Information about a customer’s service contract is found in Knowledge.
questions.explanation: Service contract details (entitlements, products, SLAs) are stored in the Service Contracts module, not in Knowledge. Knowledge articles provide solutions and documentation.

questions.stem: From what places in SN can an agent create a case? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: A=Customer Service Application, C=Account record (via related list/action), D=Chat session (agent converts to case). Contact is not a standard creation entry point.

questions.stem: What are the conditions that matching rules are based on? (Choose two.)

options.text: Agent resources best suited to work on a case
Filters set up in advanced work assignment

questions.explanation: A=Agent resources best suited to handle cases (skills, availability, workload) and D=Specific case attributes (priority, category, product).

questions.stem: Matching rules enhance assignment capability by ____________________.

options.text: Providing dynamic matching of cases to groups or individuals
Determining if account is a customer or partner

questions.explanation: Matching rules enhance assignment by dynamically matching the best available agent based on availability, skills, workload, and role - going beyond simple group-based assignment rules.

questions.stem: Special Handling Notes can apply to which one of the following based on specific attributes?
questions.explanation: Special Handling Notes apply to Contact records based on specific attributes, so agents see relevant handling instructions when working cases associated with that contact.

questions.stem: Predictive Intelligence improves Case management by:

options.text: Predicting what values should have gone into empty fields in historical records
Reducing the number of records needed to accurately predict a value
Predicting Case values without manual intervention

questions.explanation: Predictive Intelligence auto-predicts case field values (category, priority, assignment group) without manual agent input, improving triage accuracy and reducing handling time.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a condition for matching rules?
questions.explanation: Matching rules define conditions based on specific case attributes (e.g., category, priority, product) to identify which agent resources are best suited to handle those cases.

questions.stem: What do blue circles in the timeline of a case form represent?
questions.explanation: Blue circles in the CSM case form timeline represent State changes (e.g., New > In Progress > Resolved), visually indicating case progression through its lifecycle stages.

questions.stem: Predictive Intelligence improves triage quality by eliminating the guesswork. Predictive Intelligence supports which of the following decisions? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Predictive Intelligence supports C=Case Categorization (predicts category from description) and D=Case Prioritization (predicts priority). Escalation and State are not auto-predicted.

questions.stem: Which Business Rules are part of the Customer Service Management baseline configuration? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: CSM baseline Business Rules include B=Auto Assessment (triggers assessments on case close) and D=Update Case Entitlement (validates and updates entitlement data on case records).

questions.stem: What are the Critical Success Factors that are related to CSM Suite Implementations? (Choose four.)

options.text: Have a clear understanding of the use cases
Define the number of hours needed to develop the associated requirements
Implementation is only as good as the underlying process

questions.explanation: A=Define Business Pain Points, B=Provide consistent service, C=Clear use case understanding, E=Implementation quality depends on underlying process. D (development hours) is a project metric, not a CSF.

questions.stem: What should be emphasized when designing solutions? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: A=Minimize customizations (reduce upgrade risk), B=Leverage OOTB functionality (faster, supported), C=Design for scalability. Mobile (D) is a consideration but not a primary design principle.

questions.stem: What role does the Engagement Manager play before the Workshop? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A=Acts as Project Manager (planning, scheduling, stakeholder coordination) and D=Assists with technical requirements gathering and documentation.

questions.stem: What should be part of the pre-engagement collateral?

options.text: Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) and pricing sheet

questions.explanation: Scoping Guide is the primary pre-engagement collateral for CSM implementations, defining scope, objectives, deliverables, and effort estimates before the engagement begins.

questions.stem: Articles can provide the following: (Choose three.)

options.text: Provide answers and responses to common issues or questions

questions.explanation: A=Document current/known issues, B=Provide answers to common questions, D=Share product information. Service contract info (C) is stored in Service Contracts, not KB.

questions.stem: Contextual Search framework is used for providing Knowledge search results in which of these scenarios?

options.text: Both portal question entry and Record Producer

questions.explanation: Contextual Search surfaces knowledge results in both portal question entry (as customer types) and record producers (as description is entered), providing real-time deflection in both scenarios.

questions.stem: Which of the following are true regarding integrating a ServiceNow Knowledge base with external content? (Choose two.)

options.text: Imported external articles appear as attachments in ServiceNow
Only applications that allow WebDAV connections can be integrated
The imported article will have the same category it had in the source knowledge base

questions.explanation: A=Imported articles appear as attachments in ServiceNow, B=Only WebDAV-enabled applications can be integrated. SharePoint supports WebDAV and integrates successfully.

questions.stem: Access to a Knowledge base or Article can be restricted based on a customer’s assets and the product models using which of the following? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A=Knowledge Product Entitlements restricts access to KBs/articles based on owned products, D=User Criteria controls read/contribute access by user attributes.

questions.stem: What are some benefits that Knowledge Product Entitlement provide? (Choose three.)

options.text: Makes it easier for Agents to manage case volume
Allows access to Knowledge Articles that are related to products owned by a customer

questions.explanation: A=Reduces call volume (customers self-serve relevant articles), B=Simplifies agent case management, C=Customers access articles for their owned products only.

questions.stem: What are the characteristics of Knowledge Categories?

options.text: Shareable across KBs: Yes ; Multi-Level: No
Shareable across KBs: No ; Multi-Level: Yes
Shareable across KBs: No ; Multi-Level: No
Shareable across KBs: Yes ; Multi-Level: Yes

questions.explanation: Knowledge categories are NOT shareable across Knowledge Bases (each KB has its own category tree) but DO support multi-level hierarchies within a single KB.

questions.stem: Users with the sn_customerservice.proxy_contact role can do which of the following? (Choose two.)

options.text: Manage cases on behalf of customer service agents
Create cases on behalf of customers
Manage requests on behalf of customer service agents
Create requests on behalf of customers
Manage major incident communication on behalf of a customer service manager

questions.explanation: sn_customerservice.proxy_contact can B=create cases on behalf of customers and D=create requests on behalf of customers. They cannot manage cases/requests on behalf of agents.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of a Catalog Item variable?

options.text: Grants the customer the opportunity to ask a question
Opens a wizard to help a customer fill in a case form
Guides a customer by providing hints on case forms
Allows the customer or consumer to qualify their answer

questions.explanation: Catalog item variables allow customers/consumers to qualify their answers by providing specific input fields that capture requirements for the catalog item or record producer.

questions.stem: What one of the following is optional when creating a Catalog workflow?
questions.explanation: Workflow approval (C) is optional — not all catalog workflows require an approval step. Publishing (A) and defining activities (B) are required; version management is a platform feature.

questions.stem: What module is used to create Case Record Producers?
questions.explanation: Case Record Producers are created and managed via the Record Producers module (All > Service Catalog > Catalog Definitions > Record Producers), not a separate case-specific module.

questions.stem: Which one is NOT a dependency for the Customer Service Plugin?
questions.explanation: Communities is NOT a dependency of the Customer Service plugin. Automatically activated dependencies include Skills Management, Resource Matching Engine, and Openframe for CTI integration.

questions.stem: ACME corporation wants to use ServiceNow CSM for supporting their customers through Twitter. What CSM entity would you recommend ACME to store the customer’s Twitter profile details?
questions.explanation: Twitter and other social media profile details are stored in a Social Profile record, linked to an Account, Contact, or Consumer via the Social Profiles related list.

questions.stem: Which social media channels are NOT available out-of-box?
questions.explanation: Twitter and Facebook are the documented OOTB social channels. LinkedIn is not available out-of-box and requires additional configuration or integration.

questions.stem: What is the equivalent of NOT selecting any group, when configuring multiple active configurations of OpenFrame?
questions.explanation: When no user groups are selected on an OpenFrame configuration, access defaults to all users with the openframe role — equivalent to selecting all groups.

questions.stem: How many outbound email accounts are supported in Customer Service Management?
questions.explanation: Only one outbound (outgoing) email account is supported per ServiceNow instance. Multiple inbound email addresses can be configured.

questions.stem: What are features of Customer Service Management? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: Core CSM features include B=Service Entitlements, E=Real-time SLAs, F=Service Contracts, and G=Skills-based routing. Timed Audits, Demand Management, and Service Prospecting are not CSM features.

questions.stem: What are the Forum User Types? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three forum user types are B=Registered (authenticated users), C=Public (anonymous/guest users), and D=Custom (organisation-defined types). Admin and Moderator are roles, not user types.

questions.stem: Which of the following are true regarding the Community Portal application? (Choose two.)

options.text: It is available to any customer with a Community license
It is available by default with the Support and Service portals
It is only available to CSM license holders
Most of the configuration does not require System Administrator role

questions.explanation: A=Community Portal requires a separate Community license (not bundled with CSM). D=Most community configuration uses community-specific roles (sn_communities.admin, forum_admin) rather than the system administrator role.

questions.stem: If only one user reports a content for moderation, the content will be hidden.
questions.explanation: False. Content is NOT automatically hidden after a single report. An abuse reporting threshold must be configured — content is only hidden once the report count reaches the defined threshold.

questions.stem: The available case types are: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two available OOTB case types are B=Order (order-related cases) and C=Product (product support cases). Product Support and Support are not standalone OOTB case type definitions.

questions.stem: What is required to enable the Follow the sun field on the Customer Service Case form?

options.text: Nothing, it is a standard field
The value property on the form must be set to true
The plugin ‘com.snc.csm_time_recording’ needs to be activated
The value property on the form must be set to true and the field added to the case form

questions.explanation: Enabling the Follow the Sun field requires both D=setting the system property to true AND adding the field to the Case form. Neither step alone is sufficient.

questions.stem: In the Customer Service Management space, what does the term asset management mean?

options.text: Financial, contractual and inventory information of assets
A set of business activities and processes used to track assets
Tracking products or services customers are using

questions.explanation: In CSM, asset management means tracking the specific products or services that customers are using. This differs from ITSM (financial/lifecycle) or ITAM (financial) asset management definitions.

questions.stem: Which of the following roles cannot update a consumer’s record?
questions.explanation: sn_customerservice_agent cannot update consumer records. The sn_customerservice.consumer_agent role is specifically required to create and update consumer records. Standard agents only have case management access.

questions.stem: Major Issue Management uses which one of the following capabilities?
questions.explanation: Major Issue Management depends on and uses the Targeted Communications capability to send communications and manage recipient lists for impacted customers.

questions.stem: What is required to synchronize fields from a parent to a child case(s)?

options.text: The advanced plugin (com.sns.pa.customer_service_advanced) needs to be activated
Major Issue Management needs to be installed and certain properties enabled
No action required, this is a standard Customer Service Management feature
The role of sn_customerservice.customer_case_manager must be assigned

questions.explanation: Synchronising fields from parent to child cases requires B=Major Issue Management plugin installed and the sn_customerservice.parent_child_case_sync system property enabled.

questions.stem:
HOTSPOT -
Match the definitions for roles relationships.
questions.explanation: Account=customer/partner company; Contact=employee of Account with portal access; Consumer=B2C individual; Partner=external account that sells to/supports other customers.

questions.stem: Which of the following functions can be completed when using the Field Service Management Application on a mobile device offline? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: B=Execute assigned tasks, C=Close work orders, E=Manage assets. Manage requests (A) and Manage cases (D) require active server connectivity.

questions.stem: Information in the Case Field ‘Contact’ is copied to which Incident Field?
questions.explanation: When creating an Incident from a Case, the Contact field on the Case maps to the Caller field on the Incident - the customer contact becomes the incident requester/caller.

questions.stem: How many active OpenFrame configurations can you have on an instance?
questions.explanation: OpenFrame supports unlimited active configurations. Each configuration specifies window settings and URL, with access restricted to designated user groups.

questions.stem: What are common types of application record data that are imported during a CSM data migration? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A=Knowledge Articles (existing KB content) and B=Accounts (customer/partner data). Chat logs and transient case history are typically not migrated.

questions.stem: Which are the key self-service functions of the Customer Support Portal? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: A=Community (Q&A), B=Knowledge Base (find articles), D=Service Catalog (request items). Customers open Cases - not Incidents (C).

questions.stem: Which of the following are channels? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: B=Web (portal/web form) and C=Chat (live agent chat). Contacts (A) are customer entities; Articles (D) are knowledge content, not channels.

questions.stem: Out-of-the-box, the consumer support portal (/csp) CANNOT be used for which one of the following actions?
questions.explanation: Consumer Service Portal (/csp) does not support opening Incidents - consumers open Cases. The CSP does support KB browsing (B), live chat (C), and consumer self-registration (D).

questions.stem: The Customer Support Portal default configuration provides the following channels to interact with customers? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: C=Chat (live chat widget) and D=Email (inbound email). Web and Social channels require additional configuration beyond the default setup.

questions.stem:
HOTSPOT -
Match the business rule to its function in the Self-Service Portal.
questions.explanation: CSM self-service portal business rules include case deflection (surface KB articles to prevent case creation), case auto-close (resolve cases after inactivity), and routing.

questions.stem: The ServiceNow Communities feature is only available for customers with ServiceNow Customer Services Management licenses.
questions.explanation: Communities is a platform-level capability available to any ServiceNow customer - it is not exclusive to CSM licensees. Any instance can enable Community features independently.

questions.stem:
Read the use case below to determine if the customer service relationship is B2B or B2C.
Mary Contrary experiences a power outage and call the electrical company. The agent determines the outage is local to the customer and scheduled a technician to Mary’s house.
questions.explanation: Mary Contrary is an individual consumer calling an electrical utility - this is B2C (business-to-consumer). B2B applies when businesses are the customers, not individual consumers.

questions.stem: If the CSM Demo Data Plugin has been installed what are two options either of which will prepare that instance to be used as part of the release path to production? (Choose two.)

options.text: Remove the Demo Data via a HI Request
Clone back to this instance from a valid instance

questions.explanation: C=Submit a HI Request for ServiceNow to remove demo data, or D=Clone back from a valid clean instance. Zbooting destroys the full instance.

questions.stem: What criteria can be used to determine when a new inbound case should be opened?

options.text: When a new customer is created
When a customer has a question or issue to resolve
When we have new marketing material for a customer

questions.explanation: A new inbound case is opened when a customer has a question or issue to resolve. Cases are the primary CSM work item for tracking and resolving customer-reported issues.

questions.stem:
From a service provider’s perspective, is the following a product or an asset?
A cable modem model that the service provider sells.
questions.explanation: A cable modem model that a service provider sells is a Product (product model entry in the catalog). An Asset is a specific installed instance of that product at a customer location.

questions.stem: Entitlements specify the level of service provided to customers.
questions.explanation: Entitlements define the level of service a customer is entitled to under their service contract, specifying response times, support hours, and the service tier covered.

questions.stem: Partner admin contacts have access to the data of both their partner accounts and customer accounts.
questions.explanation: Partner admin contacts have access to both their own partner account data and the customer accounts they manage/support, enabling case creation and management on behalf of customers.

questions.stem: Which of the following are best practice with regard to data imports? (Choose two.)

options.text: When importing to multiple instances import to each instance separately.
Use ServiceNow automatic functionality to clean the data after it is in ServiceNow tables rather than in the legacy repository.
Ensure the field data lengths in ServiceNow are adequate for the imported data because ServiceNow does not automatically adjust the length.
Images embedded in Knowledge Articles should be uploaded separately.

questions.explanation: C=Verify field lengths are adequate (ServiceNow does not auto-adjust), D=Upload KB article images separately (embedded images do not migrate cleanly).

questions.stem: Cost Information on cases is available as part of the Performance Analytics Content Pack for Customer Service.
questions.explanation: Cost information is NOT in the standard PA Content Pack for Customer Service. Cost data requires the separate PA Content Pack - Financial Management for CSM/FSM plugin.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the Guided Decisions capability?

options.text: Provide agents with an escalation guide
Dynamically guide agents to help resolve complex cases
Provide agents with a knowledge guide

questions.explanation: Guided Decisions dynamically guides agents through structured troubleshooting steps to resolve complex cases consistently, using decision trees and conditional branching logic.

questions.stem: Which feature enables you to quickly identify high-priority tasks based on multiple dimensions, not just by a single field value like priority?
questions.explanation: Case Spotlight identifies high-priority cases by scoring them across multiple dimensions (priority, age, account, category, etc.), not just a single field value, enabling focused management attention.

questions.stem: During which Now Create stage are workshops conducted?
questions.explanation: Workshops (requirements gathering, design, etc.) are conducted during the Plan phase of the Now Create methodology, before the Execute/Deliver phases begin.

questions.stem: Which application must be activated to enable customers to check in on-line for future appointments?
questions.explanation: The Walk-Up Experience application must be activated to enable customers to book and check in online for future appointments at walk-up service locations.

questions.stem: What are some of the influencing factors that will help determine the type of customer support desk structure required? (Choose four.)

options.text: Knowledge and skills required for agents
Number and type of support tools available
Number of customer service portals used

questions.explanation: Factors that determine customer support desk structure include A=knowledge and skills required for agents, B=geographical location of customers, C=languages spoken by agents, and F=number of agents required. Support tool count and portal count are operational, not structural.

questions.stem: What is the default value in the Channel field when a new case is opened by a customer in the Service Catalog, using the Customer Service Portal?
questions.explanation: The default value in the Channel field when a case is opened from the Customer Service Portal (including via Service Catalog) is Web. This is the system default channel value.

questions.stem: When activating the Customer Service Management Demo Data plugin, which case type is available besides product case?
questions.explanation: When the Customer Service Management Demo Data plugin is activated, two case types are available: Product case and A=Order case. Other case types (Contract, FAQ, Billing) are not included in the demo data.

questions.stem: What’s the purpose of the Deactivate Special Handling Notes Scheduled Job?

options.text: Runs at the end of the month and deactivates all Special Handling notes more than 30 days old
Runs weekly and must have the Active checkbox unchecked in order for Special Handling notes to be deleted by the end of the week
Runs on demand by the System Admin who must set specific weekly schedules and set only those that are priority 1-critical to be deactivated
Runs daily at midnight, checks all active alerts and sets the status to Expired for those that have reached their expiration dates

questions.explanation: The Deactivate Special Handling Notes scheduled job runs daily at midnight. It checks all active notes and sets the status to Expired for any notes that have reached their Expires on date.

questions.stem: What does the Agent Whisper function do?

options.text: Lets agents and chat supervisors have a conversation without the requester knowing
Lets the chat supervisors have a conversation with the requester without the agent knowing
Lets agents have chat conversations with other agents without the requester knowing
Lets agents and requesters have a conversation without the chat supervisor knowing

questions.explanation: Agent Whisper allows agents and chat supervisors to have a private conversation that the customer (requester) cannot see. Supervisors use it to coach agents during live chat sessions without customer awareness.

questions.stem: Upon self-registration through the Consumer Service Portal, a record is created in: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Upon self-registration through the Consumer Service Portal, records are created in B=Consumer User table (csm_consumer_user) and C=Consumer table (csm_consumer). Contact and CSM User tables are not used for consumer self-registration.

questions.stem: Who can create a customer service case from a community discussion? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A=Customer service agents and B=Proxy case creators (sn_customerservice.proxy_case_creator) can create customer service cases from community discussions. Partners and case viewers do not have this capability.

questions.stem: The assignment workbench uses configurable matching criteria to evaluate agents in a selected group and provide an overall ranking. What are the different types of criteria available for the assignment workbench? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Three types of matching criteria: C=Scripted (custom script-based), D=Simple Match (one-to-one field matching), and E=Aggregate (query-based aggregate result). Correlation and Availability are criteria instances, not types.

questions.stem: Asset classes are defined to allow for logical grouping of assets. There are five asset classes provided to group assets, each Asset class provides unique functionality for that group of Assets in the platform. Which of the following are the asset classes used? (Choose five.)
questions.explanation: The five OOTB asset classes are A=Hardware, B=Facility, D=Software Licenses, E=Enterprise Software, and G=Consumables. Configuration assets and Network assets are not platform asset class categories.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes how the CSM application uses the Asset table?

options.text: CSM uses the Product table instead of the ITSM Asset table
CSM uses the Product Model table instead of the ITSM Asset table
ServiceNow uses the same Asset table for both CSM and ITSM, however CSM has a different subset of fields
Because CSM Assets are managed differently from ITSM Assets ServiceNow uses different Asset Tables for CSM than it does for ITSM

questions.explanation: ServiceNow uses the same Asset table (alm_asset) for both CSM and ITSM. CSM focuses on tracking products deployed for customers, while ITSM focuses on IT lifecycle management, using different subsets of fields on the same table.

questions.stem: A consumer service agent receives and accepts a case which was created by a consumer. The agent needs and requests more information from the consumer. After receiving the information, the agent proposes a solution that is accepted by the consumer. Given this scenario, what is the chronological order of case states used to manage this case?

options.text: New > Work in Progress > On Hold > Work in Progress > Resolved > Closed
New > Open > Work in Progress > Solution Proposed > Closed
Open > Pending > Work in Progress > Resolved > Closed
New > Open > Awaiting Info > Open > Resolved > Closed

questions.explanation: Chronological order: New (case created) > Open (agent accepts) > Awaiting Info (agent requests info) > Open (info received, state returns) > Resolved (solution proposed and accepted) > Closed.

questions.stem: What are the types of matching criteria for Customer Service? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: The four matching criteria for Customer Service are A=Matching Skills, B=Last Assigned, E=Assigned Cases, and F=Availability Today. Certifications, Distance, and Partner Hours are not standard CSM assignment workbench criteria.

questions.stem: What is a supported external customer that, in turn, sells to and supports one or more customers?
questions.explanation: A partner is a supported external customer that sells to and supports other customers. Partners differ from direct customer accounts in that they act as intermediaries.

questions.stem: Customer Service Trending Topics is a capability that enables companies to use Predictive Intelligence to quickly pinpoint factors driving up case volume and act to mitigate them. Which of the following would be a benefit of using Predictive Intelligence Customer Service Trending Topics?

options.text: Eliminate the need for more traditional performance analytics
Auto-generate clusters of cases that point to similar underlying issues
Create root cause solutions for similar cases
A guaranteed reduction in call volume per month

questions.explanation: A key benefit is B=auto-generating clusters of cases that point to similar underlying issues, enabling managers to identify patterns and resolve multiple related cases proactively.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow applications can be integrated out-of-the-box with CSM? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: OOTB integrations available for CSM: A=Service Portfolio Management, B=Project Management (Customer Project Management), and E=ITOM Event Management (via Proactive Customer Service Operations plugin).

questions.stem: Which of the following are benefits that may be gained from using communities? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Benefits of communities include A=reduced support costs (customer self-service deflects cases), B=customer engagement, and C=product feedback collection. Sales cost reduction and marketing effectiveness are not documented community benefits.

questions.stem: What is a case?

options.text: An individual record that handles and resolves incidents for external customers
An individual record that is used to identify and create automation opportunities
An individual record that is used to identify and resolve a question or issue for an external customer
An individual record that handles and routes issues for internal users

questions.explanation: A case is an individual record used to identify and resolve a question or issue for an external customer. Cases are the central records in the Customer Service Management application.

questions.stem: External content integration is important for agents to be able to access knowledge articles from external sources. ALL external sources must be:
questions.explanation: External KB sources must be WebDAV-compliant to integrate with ServiceNow. WebDAV is the required protocol standard for all external content integrations.

questions.stem: An Account Relationship is based on a defined account relationship hype. Users with the System Administrator role can define two types of relationships: (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: C=Account-to-account (between two customer accounts) and E=Partner-to-account (between a partner and customer account).

questions.stem: Which knowledge records can be configured with User Criteria?
questions.explanation: User Criteria can be configured on Knowledge Bases and Knowledge Articles (read/contribute access tabs). Categories do not support User Criteria configuration.

questions.stem: When the virtual agent plugin is installed NLU is activated but is not available for use until what two configurations are completed? (Choose two.)

options.text: In the NLU Settings configure the Intent confidence threshold
In the NLU Settings configure the Entity confidence threshold

questions.explanation: A=Choose the NLU service provider (e.g., IBM Watson) and C=Enable NLU in Virtual Agent settings. Confidence thresholds are optional.

questions.stem: An entitlement defines the types of support a customer receives. Entitlements are based on a number of standard fields such as product and asset. When Proactive Customer Service Operations is implemented which additional fields could be used? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: D=Install base item (specific installed product) and E=Sold product (product sold to the customer).

questions.stem: When implementing Knowledge Product Entitlements, what is enabled when activating the Enable access control of Knowledge Articles system property?

options.text: Allows access to knowledge articles based on customer’s security access
Allows access to knowledge articles that are related to entitlements owned by a customer
Allows access to multi-product line knowledge articles
Allows access to knowledge articles that are related to products owned by a customer

questions.explanation: Enabling the Knowledge Article access control property restricts article visibility to D=products owned by the customer, as defined in the Knowledge Product Entitlements application.

questions.stem: Advance Work Assignment assigns work to agents based on their availability, capacity, and skills. Agent Affinity enhances the Advanced Work Assignment process by adding additional agent details organized by affinity type. Which of these are these affinity types? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: B=Account team responsibility (agent is on the account team), C=Historical (prior customer interactions), D=Related task (affinity to an existing related task).

questions.stem: In Agent Workspace Chat, Agents have the ability to use quick actions to work more efficiently. What action does the /r quick action perform?

options.text: Rejects an incoming chat and moves it automatically to the “General” queue
Routes the chat towards another group
Uses response templates to insert as text in a conversation
Rolls up the current chat history towards an existing case

questions.explanation: /r quick action in Agent Workspace Chat opens Response Templates, allowing agents to quickly insert pre-written responses into the conversation for consistent, efficient replies.

questions.stem: Name a security benefit gained from using scoped applications:

options.text: Prevents changes to tables without explicit permission from IT
Limits accessibility to other applications in the instance
Limits the number of update sets that can be applied

questions.explanation: Application scope provides security by limiting other applications' access to an application's tables and data, preventing unauthorized cross-application reads and modifications.

questions.stem: The CSM application has a feature that can be used to filter records in CSM-related tables which are accessible by users with CSM roles. This feature makes it unnecessary to create business logic for those persona access the data. What is this feature?
questions.explanation: CSM Query Rules automatically filter records in CSM-related tables based on the user's CSM role persona, removing the need for custom business logic to control data visibility per role.

questions.stem: In Advanced Work Assignment, what does the overflow assignment capability do, if defined?

options.text: When one support group reaches capacity the work item is automatically routed to another group
Uses matching and assignment rules to send work items to the agent with the highest availability
Routes cases to different groups based on their skill set and availability
Uses matching and assignment rules to send work items to the agent with the most capacity

questions.explanation: when one support group reaches capacity, work items are automatically routed to another pre-configured overflow group to maintain service continuity.

questions.stem: Which role must B2B and B2C customers obtain, at a MINIMUM, to access to a ServiceNow instance?
questions.explanation: B2B and B2C customers need at minimum the snc_external role, which distinguishes them from internal users and grants basic external access rights to the ServiceNow instance.

questions.stem: Which Flow Designer flow can be used to automatically close resolved cases if customers do not respond within a specified time?
questions.explanation: The "Auto Close Resolved Cases" Flow Designer flow automatically closes cases in the Resolved state when customers do not respond within a configured time window.

questions.stem: What role can be assigned to employees who are not fulfillers, such as those in sales and services, or do not have other CSM-specific roles, but have a need to create cases on behalf of customers?
questions.explanation: Proxy Contact [sn_customerservice.proxy_contact] is assigned to non-fulfiller employees who need to create and manage cases on behalf of customers via phone, chat, email, or portal.

questions.stem: Proactive Customer Service Operations works Event Management to proactively monitor and fix issues affecting customers. It can also trigger case workflow’s and enable organizations to notify customers whose services or products are impacted by an outage or issue. What are the three main components that make up Proactive Customer Service Operations? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: B=Service-Aware Install Base, D=Proactive Case (auto-create cases for affected customers), F=Service Monitoring (detect service impacts).

questions.stem: Which roles are considered external? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: B=Customer Admin [sn_customerservice.customer_admin] and C=Partner Admin [sn_customerservice.partner_admin]. Consumer Support Agent and Customer Service Agent are internal roles.

questions.stem: The default configuration automatically closes resolved Cases after how many days?

options.text: Cases are not automatically closed by default

questions.explanation: Auto-close for resolved cases is NOT enabled by default - it must be explicitly activated. Default notifications send at 5 and 10 days post-resolution when configured.

questions.stem: What do blue circles in the timeline of a case form represent?
questions.explanation: Blue circles in the CSM case form timeline represent State changes (e.g., New > In Progress > Resolved), providing visual markers of case progression through lifecycle stages.

questions.stem: What are the different resource matching methods on the Matching Rule form? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: B=Scripted (custom script), C=Advanced (condition builder), D=Simple (select from user list), F=Selection Criteria (assignment workbench).

questions.stem: Which of the following child case states would cause parent - child case synchronization to fail? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: A=Resolved, E=Closed, F=Cancelled. Active states - In Progress (B), Awaiting Info (C), and New (D) - allow synchronization.

questions.stem: External customers can view the problem, change, and request records associated with their customer service cases from the Customer and Consumer Service Portals. Which of the following can they approve in relation to cases via the portals?
questions.explanation: External customers can approve B=Change Records (via change approval workflows) and Request Records (via request approval). Problems and incidents do not have customer approval workflows.

questions.stem: Playbooks for CSM provide step-by-step guidance for resolving specific types of customer service cases. What are the three out-of-the-box playbooks for CSM? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three OOTB CSM playbooks are A=Case Playbook for Onboarding, C=Case Playbook for Product Support, and D=Case Playbook for Complaints. Services and Billing playbooks are not included OOTB.

questions.stem: Based on which out-of-box attributes can Special handling Notes be applied to cases? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: OOTB SHNs can be applied based on C=Product, D=Account, and E=Contact attributes on the case. Service Contract and Install Base Item are not default SHN trigger entities.

questions.stem: As an agent you can report a knowledge gap, if you cannot find relevant articles that could help resolve a case. Which action is required to create the knowledge gap?

options.text: Document the knowledge gap in the case work notes and escalate the case
Post a question in one of the various Customer Service Management knowledge bases
Use Related Links on the case form to report a knowledge gap
Use the Create Knowledge button on the case form to report a knowledge gap

questions.explanation: To report a knowledge gap when no relevant articles are found, agents use Related Links on the case form to create a knowledge gap record, not work notes or the Create Knowledge button.

questions.stem: What feature does the Product Model and Catalog Items Relationship plugin enable?

options.text: Agents are automatically proposed catalog items related to the chosen product on the case form
Consumers can track what products they have purchased via the catalog
It provides a contextual service catalog based on the customer’s subscribed services
Customer service managers can track the financial cost of customer’s subscribed services and the related requests

questions.explanation: The Product Model and Catalog Items Relationship plugin enables a contextual service catalog — showing catalog items relevant to the specific product or service the customer is subscribed to.

questions.stem: What happens to a case whenever the state of one of the associated IT Service Management records (incident, problem, change) is updated?

options.text: The case escalates to an assignment group as defined in the default escalation template
The case work notes are updated automatically
The case action status changes to Related Task Updated
The case displays a special handling note highlighting the update

questions.explanation: When an associated ITSM record (incident, problem, change) is updated, the case work notes are automatically updated to reflect the change, keeping agents and customers informed.

questions.stem: Application Scoping from a security perspective brings the following benefits: (Choose two.)

options.text: Improves instance security by limiting access to other applications on the instance
Scoped applications prevent versioning for complex instances
Scoping hold the records and acts as a container for the desired CSM applications
Scoped applications limits autonomy and control of all aspects of the CSM application

questions.explanation: Benefits include A=improved instance security by limiting cross-application access, and C=a defined container that holds records and acts as a namespace for CSM application data.

questions.stem: How can multiple service catalogs be made available on the Customer Service Portal?

options.text: Include them in the list of service catalogs on the Customer Service Portal record
Add them to the list of service catalogs in the Customer Service Portal header widget options
Only the Customer Service service catalog can be used on the Customer Service Portal
Create user criteria for each of the applicable service catalogs

questions.explanation: Multiple service catalogs are made available on the portal by associating them in the list of service catalogs on the Customer Service Portal record configuration.

questions.stem: Now Create provides a prescriptive methodology, leading practices, and accelerators to help with ServiceNow implementations and upgrades. How many sequential project phases and exit gates are there in the Now Create Methodology?
questions.explanation: Now Create methodology has five sequential project phases (Initiate, Diagnose, Design, Build, Deploy) with exit gates between each phase, providing a structured implementation approach.

questions.stem: From which one of the following can an agent create a CSM Case:
questions.explanation: Agents can create CSM cases from Chat interactions (when handling a live chat session). HR Application, Incidents, and Special Handling Notes are not standard case creation entry points.

questions.stem: Using the out-of-the-box major issue management process flow, a consumer service agent proposes an existing case in the Open state as a major case candidate. The major case candidate has a consumer defined and is approved by the customer service manager What happens to the major case candidate?

options.text: The major case candidate becomes a major case
A new major case is created and the major case candidate is added as a child to the major case
The major case candidate requires an approval from the major issue manager
The major case candidate is closed and a new major case is created

questions.explanation: When a candidate proposed from an existing case is approved, a new major case is created and the original candidate case becomes a child case of the newly created major case.

questions.stem: What types of escalation templates can be created? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Two types of escalation templates exist: A=Case escalation (escalates the case record) and D=Account escalation (escalates the account). Sold Product and Consumer are not template types.

questions.stem: What are the recommended good practices when running implementation workshops? (Choose three.)

options.text: Give the customers the data they need so they can make an informed decision
Any financial implication of a decision should be handled by the delivery and sales team
Enforce customers to adapt their processes towards the baseline processes
Engage with customers to gain deep understanding of their organization
Guide the customer toward industry best practices

questions.explanation: A=provide customers data for informed decisions, D=engage deeply with customers to understand their organisation, E=guide toward industry best practices. Enforcing adaptation or restricting financial discussions are not recommended.

questions.stem: What is the specific type of catalog item called that allows users to create task-based records, such as case records, from the Service Catalog?
questions.explanation: A Record Producer is the specific type of catalog item that allows users to create task-based records (such as cases) from the Service Catalog by submitting a form.

questions.stem: Out-of-box, which functionality handles state transitioning for case management?
questions.explanation: State Flows handle out-of-box state transitioning for customer service cases, defining the valid state transitions and the conditions required for each transition.

questions.stem: Which of the following are benefits of customer access management? (Choose two.)

options.text: It defaults the responsibility for access management to the customer service agent.
It increases security by automatically providing access to case information based on account hierarchy
It increases automation by automatically granting access to cases based on access to sold product
It improves the customer experience by enabling related parties to track and collaborate on cases.
It defaults the responsibility for access management to the customer.

questions.explanation: Benefits: C=increases automation by granting case access based on sold product access, D=improves customer experience by enabling related parties to track and collaborate on cases.

questions.stem: What are the advantages of leading indicators over lagging indicators? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Leading indicators are B=prospective (they look forward and predict future performance) and D=easy to influence (actionable). Lagging indicators are retrospective and harder to influence.

questions.stem: Customer Service Management Administrators can delegate Contact Administration activities to specific contacts within accounts by assigning specific roles to one or more users. Which of the following roles, if assigned, would allow the user to create contacts?
questions.explanation: sn_customerservice.customer_admin (Customer admin) allows the user to create contacts and manage account users. The basic customer role only allows viewing/creating their own cases.

questions.stem: What is knowledge article versioning?

options.text: A content tracker for knowledge articles
The ability to manage and track article updates

questions.explanation: Knowledge article versioning is the ability to manage and track updates to knowledge articles over time, maintaining a history of changes with each version of the article.

questions.stem: Service providers use business models to support their various customers. What type of customer is supported with the Business-to-Consumer (B2C) model?
questions.explanation: B2C (Business-to-Consumer) supports individual consumers directly. These are private individuals interacting with an organisation, not business accounts, partners, or contacts.

questions.stem: When configuring email in Communication Channels, how many outgoing email addresses are supported?
questions.explanation: Admins can create multiple incoming email addresses but only one outgoing email address per instance is supported.

questions.stem: Which of the following roles have permission to create a relationship between a contact and an account? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: sn_customerservice_manager and admin roles have the necessary permissions to create and manage relationships between contacts and accounts in CSM.

questions.stem: In CSM Asset Management has a different meaning than in ITSM or Corporate Finance Which of the following defines Asset Management in CSM?

options.text: The process of developing, operating, maintaining, upgrading, and disposing of assets in me most cost-effective manner
A generic activity or process responsible for tracking and reporting the value and ownership of assets throughout their lifecycle
Asset management has different use cases for tracking specific products or services customers are using
It includes all of the data crucial to support customers as efficiently as possible

questions.explanation: In CSM, asset management focuses on tracking specific products or services deployed for customers, distinct from ITSM lifecycle or financial asset tracking.

questions.stem: What is KCS (Knowledge Centered Services)?

options.text: A bunch of tables strictly pertaining to CSM case articles that focus on mapping articles to Knowledge management
A documented methodology to provide a set of best practices for creating and maintaining knowledge
A dashboard with specific visualization of the different knowledge bases and categories
An application that helps agents and managers to create cases from Knowledge articles

questions.explanation: KCS (Knowledge Centered Services) is a documented methodology providing best practices for creating and maintaining knowledge as an integral part of service delivery.

questions.stem: When creating or importing assets for CSM, model categories are used to: (Choose three.)

options.text: Define whether a Configuration Item (CI) is created when an Asset record is created or vice versa
Build a classification structure for product models
Model the configuration options for each product model being sold to customers
Define a link between Asset classes and Configuration Item (CI) classes

questions.explanation: Model categories A=control CI creation from assets, B=group assets together, E=define link between asset classes and CI classes. C and D describe product model functions.

questions.stem: Viewing a customer’s install base in the CSM Workspaces enables customer service agents to: (Choose two.)

options.text: Close an upsell of related products and services not yet purchased by a customer
See the detailed configurations of the products and services deployed for a customer to determine the action needed
Trace Information provided in a case to the right product or service to which it relates
Monitor related operational services and configuration items that affect service health

questions.explanation: Viewing install base enables agents to B=see detailed configurations of deployed products and C=trace case info to the right product. A (upsell) is a sales function, not a CSM agent task.

questions.stem: Benefits of Proactive Customer Service Operations include: (Choose two.)

options.text: Major cases can be eliminated as there will be no Impact to customers

questions.explanation: Benefits include A=reduced inbound calls (customers informed proactively) and D=reduced MTTR (early detection speeds resolution). Staff turnover and guaranteed satisfaction are not documented outcomes.

questions.stem: What features are included with the Customer Service Portal? (Choose three.)

options.text: Header with links for different customer activities such as creating a case
Search feature to get information from several repositories
Links to information sources such as the knowledge base, community and customer support
Links to marketing promotions and product coupons
The ability to create new accounts

questions.explanation: Default features include A=header navigation links, B=search across repositories, C=links to KB/community/support. Marketing promotions and account creation are not default CSP features.

questions.stem: What does NLU stand for?
questions.explanation: NLU stands for Natural-Language Understanding — the AI technology powering Virtual Agent conversational capabilities and intent recognition in ServiceNow.

questions.stem: Out-of-the-box. cases are automatically closed after how many days?

options.text: Cases are not automatically closed by default

questions.explanation: Auto Close Resolved Cases is NOT enabled by default — admins must explicitly activate the flow. Default 5-day and 10-day notifications only apply when the feature is enabled.

questions.stem: When are any changes to the platform considered a customization?

options.text: When they require an implementation spread across all project phases
If they are NOT applied through the usage of built-in tools on the Now Platform
When they are solely implemented for a custom application
When there are business demands for custom functionality that is not offered out-of-the-box

questions.explanation: In ServiceNow, a customization is any change driven by business demand for functionality not available OOTB. Configuration uses built-in tools within supported patterns; customization goes beyond them.

questions.stem: Which solution must be implemented to let a breakdown dashboard appear as a pop-up window on the case form?
questions.explanation: In-form Analytics enables breakdown dashboards to display as pop-up windows within the case form, providing contextual data without navigating away from the record.

questions.stem: The case digests feature includes which types of case communication? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Case digests include exactly two types: B=Case Action Summaries (periodic updates during active cases) and C=Post Case Reviews (resolution summaries after closure).

questions.stem: By default what can customers with the customer (sn_customerservice.customer) role see on the customer service portal? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Contacts with sn_customerservice.customer role can view A=Assets, B=Publications, and C=Products on the CSP by default. Contacts and Contracts require elevated permissions.

questions.stem: Which feature allows an agent to copy reusable messages to case or task forms to provide quick and consistent messages to users?
questions.explanation: Response Templates are pre-written reusable messages agents can copy into case or task forms for quick, consistent customer communications.

questions.stem: In the Customer Service Management space what defines the term asset?

options.text: A specific product instance supported for a customer
A product that a company supports
A resource that allows a business service

questions.explanation: In CSM, an asset is a specific product or instance supported for a customer — distinct from ITSM configuration items or corporate finance depreciable assets.

questions.stem: Which capabilities does the integration with Microsoft Outlook add-in offer? (Choose two.)

options.text: Escalate a case on the add-m panel of Outlook
Register the sender of an email as contact
As the Microsoft Outlook user, register yourself as self-contributor
Create cases using email content in Outlook for the customer contact

questions.explanation: The Outlook add-in enables B=registering email senders as new contacts and D=creating cases from email content. Escalation and self-contributor registration are not documented features.

questions.stem: To which entities can Special Handling Notes be applied out of the box?
questions.explanation: OOTB, Special Handling Notes apply to Consumer records. Additional entity tables require explicit configuration. Entitlements and sold products are not default SHN entities.

questions.stem: Which service catalogs are available out-of-the-box in the customer portals? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Two OOTB catalogs exist: B=Customer Service Catalog (B2B portal) and C=Consumer Service Catalog (B2C/CSP). Partner Service and Product Service are not default catalog names.

questions.stem: Partner admin (sn_customerservice.partner_admin) contacts have access to:
questions.explanation: Partner administrators have access to both their own partner account and the customer accounts they manage, enabling case creation and management on behalf of customers.

questions.stem: From a security perspective, scoping brings several benefits: (Choose two.)

options.text: Improves instance security by limiting accessibility to other applications on the instance
Provides CSM teams the autonomy and control needed to configure and manage the CSM application, but not the CSM Service Portals
IT can manage and control the pace of the CSM teams because dependencies have been put in place
The scope holds the records and acts as a container for the desired Customer Service Management Applications

questions.explanation: A=improves instance security by limiting cross-application accessibility; D=the scope acts as a container holding all records for the desired CSM applications. Scoping gives CSM independence from IT, not the other way around.

questions.stem: Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) pushes work to qualified agents using work item queues, routing conditions, and assignment criteria that you define. Which step would ensure the work was allocated to the appropriate agent?

options.text: Set the Agent Experience (What agents see in their Workspace inbox)
Define Assignment Rules (How to assign work items)
Define Work Item Queues (Where to route)

questions.explanation: Defining Assignment Rules is the step that ensures work is allocated to the appropriate agent, by configuring how work items are matched to agents (Most Capacity, skills-based, etc.) within the selected group.

questions.stem: What action can be performed by a Partner Admin (sn_customerservice.partner_admin) and NOT by a Partner (sn_customerservice partner) in the Customer Service Portal?

options.text: Can view assets belonging to their partner accounts
Can create, view, and edit cases for their partner accounts
Can resolve cases reported by their partner accounts
Can create and update contacts for their partner accounts

questions.explanation: Partner admins (sn_customerservice.partner_admin) can D=create and update contacts for their partner accounts. Regular partners (sn_customerservice.partner) can only view and create cases — not manage contact records.

questions.stem: What is a household entity?

options.text: Group of users that usually share a common address and use services as a group
Group of people that usually share a common address and use services as a group
Group of customers that usually share a common address and use services as a group
Group of consumers that usually share a common address and use services as a group

questions.explanation: A household entity is a group of consumers that usually share a common address and use services as a group. The key term is "consumers," not general customers, people, or users.

questions.stem: Why does the implementation team need to deliver core functionality to the customer as quickly as possible?

options.text: To facilitate the requirement gathering during the workshops
To complete any complex customizations early enough
To realize near-term ROI (Return on Investment)

questions.explanation: Delivering core functionality to the customer as quickly as possible enables near-term ROI (Return on Investment), allowing customers to realise value from the solution early while additional features are developed.

questions.stem: Assignment workbench enables customer service managers to assign tasks to agents via configurable criteria known as Matching Rules. Which out-of-the-box configurable criteria can be used? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Three OOTB configurable matching criteria: A=Assigned Cases, C=Availability Today, and D=Matching Skills. Agent Affinity and Agent History are not OOTB assignment workbench criteria.

questions.stem: Regarding Account Teams, what is the purpose of marking a role as 'unique'?

options.text: The role then becomes a child responsibility
Ensure there is a dedicated account manager for that account
The role then becomes a parent responsibility
Prevent the same role being used on different customer accounts

questions.explanation: Marking a role as unique ensures only one person can hold that role per account (e.g., one Account Manager per account), while the same person can still manage multiple accounts.

questions.stem: Configuration items (CIs) are entities that capture the individual configurations for each product sold to the customer CIs are stored in the configuration management database (CMDB). Assets are specific product instances that are supported for a customer. Which of the following statements is correct for CIs and assets?

options.text: The contract and entitlements of an asset dictate whether or not it is stored in the CMDB
The CMDB only tracks CIs, assets cannot be CIs
While the CMDB may track some assets as configuration items (CIs) not ALL assets are CIs
The CMDB tracks all assets as configuration items (CIs)

questions.explanation: While the CMDB may track some assets as configuration items, not ALL assets are CIs. Consumables, software licenses, and financial assets may be tracked as assets without having a corresponding CI in the CMDB.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct when the 'Contact Local Time' field is enabled in a case form?

options.text: The field is not based of the customers profile time zone
The field is active in the base form
The field is always based on the system time zone
Agents can use the field to identify if it is the right time to contact customer

questions.explanation: The Contact Local Time field on the case form shows the customer's local time, enabling agents to identify whether it is an appropriate time to contact the customer before calling or reaching out.

questions.stem: Which of the following roles can update a consumer's record? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A=sn_customerservice.consumer_agent and B=sn_customerservice_manager can update consumer records. The standard sn_customerservice_agent role does NOT have update access to consumer records.

questions.stem: Which CSM Configurable Workspace feature enables agents to quickly view records in the contextual side panel without switching tabs?
questions.explanation: Dynamic Related Records enables agents to view related records in the contextual side panel without switching tabs, dynamically changing based on the current record context.

questions.stem: With the Auto Close Resolved Cases flow enabled, and using its default settings, when will a reminder be sent to a non-responsive customer0
questions.explanation: With default settings enabled, a first reminder notification is sent to the customer after 5 days. A second reminder is sent after 10 days, after which the case is auto-closed if no response.

questions.stem: The self-registration feature enables new customer contacts to submit registration requests from the customer portal. Which role is responsible for creating the unique registration code for each account?
questions.explanation: The system administrator is responsible for creating the unique registration code for each account that enables new customer contacts to self-register through the Customer Service Portal.

questions.stem: What action is required to enable agents to create an incident record for a case?

options.text: They must be assigned with the read role for incident
They must be assigned with the itil role
They must be assigned with the snc_intemal role
They must be assigned with the sn_customerservice.itsm_contributor role

questions.explanation: To enable agents to create incident records from a case, agents must be assigned the itil role. The CSM/ITSM integration plugins do not automatically grant incident creation rights to CSM agents.

questions.stem: In the ’Action Status' column on a case list what could a red indicator dot mean? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A red indicator can mean C=the case is blocked both internally (by tasks) and by the customer (waiting for information), or D=the case is blocked internally only (by related tasks, problems, or changes).

questions.stem: Which of the following are correct for parent/child synchronization? (Choose two.)

options.text: Multiple child cases can be managed from a parent case as in Major Issue Management
The Administrator can choose which fields to synchronize from parent to child cases
Parent to child cases can be synchronized regardless of which state the case is in
The property to synchronize parent to child cases is automatically enabled

questions.explanation: A=Multiple child cases can be managed from a parent (major) case in Major Issue Management; B=admin configures which specific fields synchronise via a comma-separated list property. Sync is not auto-enabled; state restrictions apply.

questions.stem: When the channel field on a case form is set to Social where are details of the social media conversations related to the case stored?
questions.explanation: Social media conversations related to a case are stored in the Social Logs related list on the Case form, not in social profiles or work notes.

questions.stem: Once a major case candidate is approved a major case is created. What then happens to the customer case?

options.text: The customer case becomes a child case of the major case
The customer case will be automatically closed
The customer case becomes the parent case of the major case
The customer case will automatically be related to a problem

questions.explanation: After a major case candidate is approved and a major case is created, the original customer case becomes a child case of the newly created major case. It is not closed or related to a problem automatically.

questions.stem: What are the types of units used to measure entitlements? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two unit types used to measure and track entitlement usage are A=Hours (time-based support) and D=Cases (incident-based support). Contract, Cost, and days are not entitlement unit types.

questions.stem: How are ServiceNow’s out-of-the-box Customer Service Management applications packaged? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: OOTB CSM applications are packaged as A=Store Apps (installed from the ServiceNow Store) and D=Plugins (activated directly in the instance). Update sets and private scopes are not standard CSM distribution methods.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct regarding product models in CSM?

options.text: Products models can only contain digital (logical) items
Product models can contain either physical items or digital (logical) items but not both in the same model
Product models can only contain physical items
Product models can contain both physical items and digital (logical) items in the same mode

questions.explanation: Product models can contain both physical items (hardware, consumables) and digital/logical items (software, services) within the same model.

questions.stem: Which of the following is correct regarding the create contact (consumer) feature in CSM Workspaces?

options.text: The create contact (consumer) feature is available in all CSM Workspaces
The create contact (consumer) feature is not available in any of the CSM Workspaces
The create contact (consumer) feature is only available in the CSM Configurable Workspace
The create contact (consumer) feature is only available in the Agent Workspace

questions.explanation: The create contact/consumer feature is only available in CSM Configurable Workspace via the contextual side panel. It is not available in Agent Workspace.

questions.stem: Depending on which CSM workspace you are operating within, certain steps can be applied to configure the form header. Which of the following is correct regarding form headers in the CSM Configurable workspace?

options.text: The form header's secondary values can only he displayed above the ribbon components
The form header's primary values can be displayed in the contextual side panes instead of above the ribbon components
The form header's secondary values can be displayed in the contextual side panel instead of above the ribbon components
The form header for the case form can display five levels of field values from the case table

questions.explanation: Form header secondary values can be configured to display in the contextual side panel instead of above the ribbon components. Primary values always display above the ribbon.

questions.stem: User criteria records may be applied to which knowledge items?
questions.explanation: User Criteria records can be applied to Knowledge Bases (access) and Knowledge Articles (read/contribute tabs). Categories do not support User Criteria configuration.

questions.stem: What are the three main components that make up Proactive Customer Service Operations? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three main components are A=Service Monitoring (detect impacts), D=Service-Aware Install Base (track deployed products), E=Proactive Case (auto-create cases for affected customers).

questions.stem: What are the three out-of-the-box playbooks for CSM? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Three OOTB CSM playbooks: A=Case Playbook for Onboarding, D=Case Playbook for Product Support, E=Case Playbook for Complaints. Billing and Accounts playbooks are not included OOTB.

questions.stem: Which of the following allows you to install out-of-the-box Customer Service Management applications within your ServiceNow instance? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: OOTB CSM applications are installed via B=Plugins (activated in the instance) and C=Store Apps (from the ServiceNow Store). XML unloads and Update Sets are not standard CSM installation methods.

questions.stem: What are available matching criteria for case assignment in Customer Service Management? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: The three matching criteria are B=Matching Skills, E=Assigned Cases, and F=Availability Today. Partner Hours, Distance, and Certifications are not CSM case assignment criteria.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the sidebar feature in CSM Configurable Workspace?

options.text: Enables agents to keep information regarding details of the case visible at all times
Enables agents to access response templates to help them resolve cases faster and more efficiently
To enable agents to collaborate with other agents or Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in real-time for faster case resolution
Enables managers to discreetly monitor chats between agents and customers

questions.explanation: The sidebar feature enables agents to collaborate in real-time with other agents or Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) for faster case resolution.

questions.stem: What is the specific type of catalog item that allows users to create any type of task, such as cases, from the Service Catalog?
questions.explanation: A Record Producer is the specific catalog item type that allows users to create any type of task (cases, incidents, etc.) from the Service Catalog by submitting a form.

questions.stem: Which feature sends an email notification containing a list of relevant knowledge articles to the case submitter and watchlist users associated with the case whenever a case is created?
questions.explanation: Auto-Responder automatically sends email notifications containing relevant KB articles to the case submitter and watchlist users whenever a case is created, enabling self-service resolution.

questions.stem: Depending on the CSM application configurations, cases can be assigned to agents manually or by using auto-assignment. Which routing and assignment features leverage matching rules? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: B=Assignment Workbench and C=Assignment Rules both leverage matching rules to evaluate and rank agents. State Flows and CSM Workspace do not use matching rules for assignment.

questions.stem: What does Major issue Management use to identify all other customers impacted by a major case?
questions.explanation: Major Issue Management uses Recipient lists to identify all other customers impacted by a major case and to coordinate notifications.

questions.stem: Which of the following is correct regarding the social med a channel?

options.text: Cases cannot be created from any of the social channels
Cases are NOT created automatically from any of the social channels
Cases can be created automatically depending on which social channel is used
Cases are created automatically from all of the social channels

questions.explanation: Case auto-creation from social media depends on which social channel is used — some channels support automatic case creation while others require manual agent action.

questions.stem: When integrating Customer Service Management with IT Service management what separate action is required for Request Management?

options.text: Activation of the Customer Service with Service Management plugin (com.sn_cs_sm)
Activation of the Customer Service with Request Management plugin (com.sn_cs_sm_request)
Activation of the Customer Service Case Action Status plugin (com.snc.csm_action_status)
Activation of the Customer Service plugin (com.sn_customerservice)

questions.explanation: Integrating CSM with ITSM for Request Management requires separate activation of the Customer Service with Request Management plugin (com.sn_cs_sm_request), beyond the base Customer Service with Service Management plugin.

questions.stem: New case tasks use the following prefix:

options.text: No specific task prefix just existing TASK prefix

questions.explanation: Case tasks in CSM use the CSTASK prefix for their task numbers, distinct from standard platform tasks (TASK) and other task types.

questions.stem: When are child cases updated from the parent case?

options.text: Clicking on the Child Sync UI
When the Sync scheduled job runs

questions.explanation: Child cases are updated automatically when the parent case is saved. A confirmation pop-up appears before synchronization applies to all child cases.

questions.stem: Which of the following features are specific to CSM Workspaces and will not be found in the Platform UI view? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: B=Lookup and verify and D=Agent Assist are workspace-specific features not available in the Platform UI. Special handling notes and related search are available in both interfaces.

questions.stem: Customer service agents can use Agent Assist to search for information from an interaction. BY DEFAULT, what are the available search sources? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: By default, Agent Assist searches A=Knowledge articles, B=Service catalog, and C=Communities. Consumer and Customer service portals are not default Agent Assist search sources.

questions.stem: Entitlements are counted using two types of units:
questions.explanation: Entitlements track usage in two unit types: Hours (time-based support) and Cases (incident-based support). SLAs, assets, days, and products are not entitlement unit types.

questions.stem: Service-aware Install Base consists of which entities? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Service-aware Install Base consists of three entities: A=Installed Products, B=Install Base Items, and D=Sold Products. Assets and Configuration Items are separate platform concepts.

questions.stem: What is the primary output from the Requirements Gathering workshop?
questions.explanation: The primary output of a Requirements Gathering workshop is User Stories — structured statements capturing functional needs from user perspectives, used to drive the implementation design.

questions.stem: What is a limitation regarding synchronization between a case and its associated work order?

options.text: If information changes on the Case form it is not updated on the Work Order form
Updates on a case or work order will only synchronize after the work order is approved
When creating a work order from a case only the Account field on the work order form is filed in but not the Company field
The data copied over to the Work Order form when creating a work order from a case cannot be configured or customized

questions.explanation: Case-to-work order synchronisation is one-directional at creation time. If information changes on the Case form afterwards, it is NOT automatically updated on the associated Work Order form.

questions.stem: Which roles can propose a case as a Major Case candidate? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Roles that can propose a case as a major case candidate: C=sn_customerservice_manager, D=sn_customerservice_agent, and E=sn_majorissue_mgt.major_issue_manager. External customer roles (proxy_contact, customer_case_manager) cannot.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a required field in the Resolution Information tad in order to close a case?
questions.explanation: Resolution notes are a required field in the Resolution Information tab that must be entered before a case can be resolved or closed. Resolution Code is also mandatory when proposing a solution.

questions.stem: Access to a Knowledge base or Article can be restricted based on a customer’s assets and the product models using which of the following?
questions.explanation: Knowledge Product Entitlements restricts KB and article access based on a customer's purchased products and assets. This limits portal-visible knowledge to what is relevant to the customer's entitlements.

questions.stem: What benefits does scoping an application bring? (Choose three.)

options.text: CSM teams can move at their desired pace, independent of IT
Provides CSM teams autonomy and control
CSM application data and business logic is protected from changes by other applications
Account records can be changed only while in the CSM scope
Changes in different scopes can be addressed in a single update set
