questions.explanation: Benefits: A=CSM teams move independently of broader IT schedules, B=CSM teams gain autonomy and control over their application, C=CSM data and business logic is isolated and protected from other application changes.

questions.stem: A customer service agent wants to escalate an account but is unable to use the Escalate Account related link on the Account form. What could be the reasons why the customer service agent is not able to use it? (Choose two.)

options.text: No escalation approval flow is configured
The parent account of the account to be escalated is not active
The customer service agent is not assigned with the escalation requester role
The account already has an open escalation record

questions.explanation: Agent cannot use Escalate Account if C=they are not assigned the escalation requester role, or D=the account already has an open escalation record (only one active escalation per account is allowed).

questions.stem: After installing the Performance Analytics Content Pack for Customer Service, which job must be run to retrieve daily case data from previous months?
questions.explanation: After installing the Performance Analytics Content Pack, the Customer Service Historic Data Collection job must be run to backfill daily case data from previous months for historical analysis.

questions.stem: When working with communication channels, what inbound email flows are available by default? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two OOTB inbound email flows are D=Create case from email and E=Update case using reply (handle email replies). Create case for product/asset and forward email update are not default flows.

questions.stem: What determines how an escalation request is processed?
questions.explanation: An escalation template determines how an escalation request is processed, defining the escalation type, whether approval is required, the approval subflow, and the watch list.

questions.stem: What allows the implementation of phases and tasks to meet performance goals track progress and measure success?
questions.explanation: CIM allows implementation of phases and tasks to meet performance goals, track progress toward improvement objectives, and measure success against defined targets.

questions.stem: For security purposes certain roles cannot be assigned to a group or individual at the same time. Which of me following two roles would be restricted?
questions.explanation: snc_internal and snc_external cannot be assigned simultaneously to a user or group. The platform aborts any operation that would result in a user having both explicit internal and external roles.

questions.stem: What are Special Handling Notes used for?

options.text: Bring important information about individual records to an agent's attention
For agents to view articles an attach them to a case
To ensure customers get the service they are entitled to receive
Help agents identify in which time zone a contact is located

questions.explanation: Special Handling Notes bring important information about individual records (such as a case or account) to the agent's attention, enabling special treatment or awareness for that record.

questions.stem: A customer service manager would like to limit the reading and creation of knowledge articles within a specific Knowledge Base to the Customer Support group only. Which features should be used to accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.text: Whitelist all other groups from the Knowledge Base
Hide the Knowledge Base from the Knowledge Base Portal

questions.explanation: To restrict KB reading and article creation to Customer Support group only: A=configure Can Read user criteria (limits who can read) and D=Cannot Contribute user criteria (limits who can create articles).

questions.stem: In case management, Parent Child Synchronization allows for which of the following:

options.text: Enabling the Customer Service agent to create cases so that all the children cases can be managed by managing the parent case
Parent cases to automatically generate child cases when all fields are filled out thus synchronized auto-population
Child cases to be separated from Parent cases and will not be synchronized automatically
Synchronization of all child cases as well as children of child cases on all levels

questions.explanation: Parent-Child Synchronisation enables managing child cases through the parent — when fields are saved on the parent, selected fields are synchronised to all associated child cases automatically.

questions.stem: Which predefined conversations are available for Customer Service Virtual Agent? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The two predefined conversations for Customer Service Virtual Agent are B=Check Case Status and D=Get Help with an Order. Create Contact, Close Case, and Get Help with an Asset are not OOTB VA topics.

questions.stem: What will be the state of a case after a customer rejects the solution proposed by an agent?
questions.explanation: When a customer rejects the solution proposed by an agent, the case state changes back to Open. The agent must then continue working on the case to find an acceptable resolution.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is correct with regards to partners vs. third-parties in ServiceNow’s CSM application? (Choose two.)

options.text: A partner will own the relationship with their customer
A partner and a third party are the same in ServiceNow’s CSM application
A partner does not own the relationship with a customer. This relationship is owned by the organization they are partnering
A partner is an organization that has been contracted to sell products and services they have actually purchased from another organization
A partner does not own any of the products or services provided by their partnering organization, instead they help to sell, deliver and support them on their behalf

questions.explanation: C=A partner does not own the customer relationship (owned by the organisation they partner with). E=A partner does not own the products/services; they help sell, deliver and support them on the organisation's behalf.

questions.stem: Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) automatically routes and assigns work items to agents based on which of the following rules? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: Advanced Work Assignment routes and assigns work items based on B=Skills, C=Availability, D=Shifts (when agents are scheduled to work), and E=Capacity. Experience and product knowledge are not AWA routing criteria.

questions.stem: Installing the Customer Service Management plugin activates:

options.text: Only one other plugin - Field Service Management Plugin
Only two other plugins - Portal and Case Management
Many other plugins at the same time

questions.explanation: Installing the Customer Service plugin (com.sn_customerservice) activates many other related plugins simultaneously, including portal, case management, and various service features.

questions.stem: From which places in ServiceNow can a customer service agent [sn_customerservice_agent] create a case? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Agents with sn_customerservice_agent can create cases from A=Account records, C=the Customer Service Application, and E=Chat interactions. Incidents and Special Handling Notes do not create cases directly.

questions.stem: Which table must be extended when creating a new case type?
questions.explanation: Creating a new case type requires creating a new table that extends the Case table (sn_customerservice_case). A case type definition record is then added to the Case Type table (sn_case_type).

questions.stem: What are benefits of me Conversation History feature? (Choose two.)

options.text: Shorter calls for agents by reducing the time to search for information
A customized admin chat toolbar with emojis for agents to use in chat messages
Improved customer satisfaction as agents can respond to and resolve customer issues faster
Better language management by flagging key words and alerting chat managers when agents use one or more of those words

questions.explanation: Benefits include A=shorter agent calls (prior context reduces repeat questioning) and C=improved customer satisfaction through faster issue resolution. Emoji toolbars and keyword flagging are not Conversation History features.

questions.stem: What is the benefit of a phased release approach?

options.text: Team members schedules are able to synchronize
Working across multiple systems of record

questions.explanation: A phased release approach delivers core functionality quickly to users, allowing early value realisation while additional features are developed and released in subsequent phases.

questions.stem: On the Customer Service Portal which personas can see work orders from their company hierarchy? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: On the Customer Service Portal, A=Partner admin and C=Customer admin can view work orders across their company hierarchy. Regular contacts and partners can only see their own work order records.

questions.stem: What is the most efficient way to get cases to be dosed automatically after a few days?

options.text: Set the property glide.auto.close.cases resolved to true
Create a workflow associated with cases with a timer that changes the state after a few days
Create a Scheduled job that looks at the resolved_at date
Activate the Auto Close Resolved Cases flow

questions.explanation: The most efficient approach is to activate the OOTB Auto Close Resolved Cases flow, which handles automatic closure of resolved cases without custom workflows or scheduled jobs.

questions.stem: Which roles can specify both skills and mandatory skills for cases and tasks? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Both A=sn_customerservice_manager and B=sn_customerservice_agent roles can specify skills and mandatory skills for cases and tasks. External customer roles do not have this capability.

questions.stem: An account is a supported external customer and a contact is a user who is an employee of an account. How many accounts can a contact be associated with?
questions.explanation: A contact is an employee of an account and can be associated with only one account. Contacts can have multiple assets and service contracts but only one parent account.

questions.stem: A contact can submit a self-registration request from the customer portal with a registration code. Which of the following roles can approve the request? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Self-registration requests can be approved by B=admin, C=customer_admin (sn_customerservice.customer_admin), and D=partner_admin (sn_customerservice.partner_admin). Customer service managers and service org admins cannot approve.

questions.stem: What benefits can be gained by integrating CSM with Field Service Management? (Choose two.)

options.text: Work orders can be created from a case
Customer can access work order details and tasks created for their case

questions.explanation: Benefits of CSM+FSM integration: C=work orders can be created directly from a case, and D=customers can access work order details and tasks from the customer portal.

questions.stem: Guided decisions is a decision authoring and execution capability that dynamically guides agents to resolve complex cases. Guided decisions consist of decision trees. What is a decision tree?

options.text: A step-by-step methodology for creating and solving different case types
A detailed check list for customer service teams
A multi-step process consisting of a series of questions answers, and guidance
A set of steps used to define a complex process

questions.explanation: A decision tree is a multi-step process consisting of a series of questions, answers, and guidance that agents work through to consistently resolve complex cases.

questions.stem: In the 'Action Status' column on a case list, what could a blue indicator dot mean?
questions.explanation: A blue indicator in the Action Status column means "Needs attention" — the case has been updated by a customer or has an unread message requiring agent action.

questions.stem: Customer service personnel who are allocated the customer service agent (sn_customerservice_agent) role are responsible for which of the following tasks? (Choose four.)

options.text: Assist customers with questions, issues and problems
View, edit, and work on cases

questions.explanation: sn_customerservice_agent responsibilities: A=assist customers, B=create cases, C=propose major cases, D=view/edit/work cases. Approving contacts (E) and managing entitlements (F) require manager/admin roles.

questions.stem: The ServiceNow add-in for Microsoft Outlook enables you to manage workflows such as creating and updating contacts and cases from within Microsoft Outlook. How could this feature positively affect customer experience?

options.text: As email is being used fewer agents would be required to create cases so service costs would go down
It is easier to report on data in emails which means managers would be better placed to track performance
It can lead to taster resolution of customer issues and faster response to customer inquiries
It would guarantee less wait time for customers who chose to call the customer service center

questions.explanation: The Outlook add-in improves customer experience by C=enabling faster case creation and contact management directly from emails, leading to quicker resolution of customer issues.

questions.stem: In ServiceNow’s CSM Application, what is an interaction?

options.text: Any configuration item that has been made accessible to customers
A record that a Customer Service Agent uses to identify and resolve a question or an issue for an external customer
A binding agreement between two parties
A request for assistance made through a chat, phone call, or walk-up

questions.explanation: An interaction in CSM is a request for assistance made through a chat session, phone call, or walk-up encounter. It is the initial touchpoint record created when a customer contacts support.

questions.stem: Which services does a Customer (sn_customerservice.customer) have access to? (Choose two.)

options.text: Can research questions issues, or problems, and create view and edit cases for only their own accounts
Can assign the roles to other contacts in the same account
Can view assets belonging to their account
Can edit information or roles for existing contacts

questions.explanation: sn_customerservice.customer can A=research issues and create/view/edit their own cases, and C=view assets belonging to their account. Role assignment and contact editing require customer_admin.

questions.stem: To which recipient types can targeted communications (publications) be sent? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Publications can be sent to B=Contacts (external portal users) and C=Internal users. Outsourced service providers and households are not supported publication recipient types.

questions.stem: What does viewing a customer’s install base enable customer service agents to do? (Choose two.)

options.text: See the detailed configurations of the products and services deployed for a customer to determine me action needed
Monitor alerts for operational services and configuration items that affect service health
Trace information provided m a case to the right product or service to which it relates
Close an upsell of related products and services not yet purchased by a customer

questions.explanation: Viewing the install base enables agents to A=see detailed configurations of deployed products/services and C=trace case information to the correct product. Monitoring operational alerts and upselling are not install base viewing functions.

questions.stem: Which step in Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) would ensure the work was allocated to the appropriate agent?
questions.explanation: Defining Assignment Rules in AWA ensures work items are routed to the appropriate agent by evaluating matching criteria such as skills, availability, and workload within the assignment queue.

questions.stem: When working with case types, what is the lowest level in the case type hierarchy called?
questions.explanation: In a case type hierarchy, the lowest level — the one with no child case types beneath it — is called the leaf-level. Case types are organised in a tree and agents select from the leaf-level types when creating cases.

questions.stem: Which roles are responsible for maintaining account team membership? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: C=System administrators and D=Customer service managers are responsible for maintaining account team membership. External customer roles (customer_admin, customer_case_manager) do not manage internal account team configurations.

questions.stem: What can a person assigned with the customer role access on the customer service portal by default? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: By default, contacts with sn_customerservice.customer can access A=Cases (their own), C=Assets (belonging to their account), and E=Sold Products. Related parties and social profiles require elevated roles.

questions.stem: Which of the following are benefits of customer access management? (Choose two.)

options.text: It increases security by automatically granting access to cases based on access to sold product.
It defaults the responsibility for access management to the customer.
It defaults the responsibility for access management to the customer service agent.
It improves the customer experience by enabling related parties to track and collaborate on cases.

questions.explanation: A=Increases automation by automatically granting case access based on access to sold products; D=improves customer experience by enabling related parties to track and collaborate on cases.

questions.stem: Which ServiceNow products can be integrated out-of-the-box with CSM? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: OOTB integrations available for CSM: A=ITOM Event Management (Proactive CSO plugin), C=Strategic Portfolio Management (service offering association), E=Financial Management. Risk Management and DevOps are not standard OOTB CSM integrations.

questions.stem: When activating the Customer Service Management Demo Data plugin, which case type is available besides product case?
questions.explanation: When the Customer Service Management Demo Data plugin is activated, A=Order case type is available alongside the Product case type. Other case types (Offer, Monitoring, FAQ, Request, Contract) are not included in the demo data.

questions.stem: What are the different resource matching methods on the Matching Rule form? (Choose four.)
questions.explanation: Four resource matching methods: A=Simple (select from user list), B=Advanced (build conditions), C=Selection Criteria (matching criteria for assignment workbench), F=Scripted (custom script). Skill and Affinity are not matching methods.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the Guided Decisions capability?

options.text: Provide agents with an escalation guide
Dynamically assist agents through account management
Dynamically help agents to resolve complex cases
Provide agents with a knowledge guide

questions.explanation: Guided Decisions dynamically helps agents resolve complex cases by providing structured troubleshooting processes and decision trees that guide agents through a consistent resolution path.

questions.stem: Which feature enables employees to request support for themselves and for external customers?
questions.explanation: The Contributor Users feature enables employees to request support for themselves and for external customers, and allows service organisations to serve one another through middle office teams.

questions.stem: What functionality is required to automatically close resolved cases if customers do not respond within a specified time?

options.text: Auto Close Resolved Cases Business Rule
Auto Close Resolved Cases Scheduled Job
Auto Close Resolved Cases Flow Designer Flow

questions.explanation: The Auto Close Resolved Cases Flow Designer Flow must be activated to automatically close resolved cases when customers do not respond within the configured time window.

questions.stem: Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) automatically routes and assigns work items to agents based on which of the following rules? (Choose three.)
questions.explanation: Advanced Work Assignment routes and assigns work items based on B=Skills (agent qualifications), D=Schedule (agent availability by shift), and E=Workload/Capacity. Experience and product knowledge are not AWA assignment criteria.

questions.stem: Which feature provides easy-to-configure integrations between the Now Platform and third-party Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools or platforms?
questions.explanation: Integration Hub provides easy-to-configure, pre-built integrations between the Now Platform and third-party CRM and ERP tools or platforms, using reusable spokes and actions.

questions.stem: Which table does the Account (customer_account) table extend?
questions.explanation: The Account table (customer_account) extends the Company table (core_company). This means accounts inherit all company fields and add customer-specific attributes on top.

questions.stem: Which combination of roles is restricted for security purposes?
questions.explanation: snc_internal (internal role) and partner_admin (external-facing role) are restricted from being assigned simultaneously. Partner admin implies snc_external access, creating a conflict with the mutually exclusive snc_internal role.

questions.stem: What must a system administrator configure to define a different approval workflow for an escalation request?
questions.explanation: To define a different approval workflow for escalation requests, configure the Escalation Template. The template has an Escalation Approval Workflow field where a custom approval flow can be selected instead of the default.

questions.stem: Which entity represents specific versions of products being sold to and supported for customers?
questions.explanation: Product models represent specific versions or configurations of products being sold and supported (e.g., a specific hardware model with defined specifications). Sold Products track what was purchased by a specific customer.

questions.stem: After an assignment group is chosen, which mandatory step in Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) ensures the work is allocated to the appropriate agent?
questions.explanation: After an assignment group is chosen, the mandatory step is D=Define Assignment Rules. Assignment Rules specify the routing logic (such as Most Capacity) that determines which specific agent within the group receives the work item.

questions.stem: Which decisions does Predictive Intelligence support? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Predictive Intelligence supports B=Case Prioritization and C=Case Categorization — predicting priority, category, and assignment group from case description. Escalation and resolution decisions are not PI use cases.

questions.stem: What is the term for a formal agreement between a service provider and a customer that provides the customer with an expectation of service within a known timescale?
questions.explanation: A Service Level Agreement (SLA) is a formal agreement between a service provider and a customer that establishes expected service levels and the timescales within which service will be delivered or issues resolved.

questions.stem: Which Service-Aware Install Base entity defines configuration items accessible to customers?
questions.explanation: An Install Base Item is any configuration item (CI) that has been made accessible to customers. It is the entity in Service-Aware Install Base that defines which CIs customers can view and interact with.

questions.stem: What are examples of what Guided Setup provides? (Choose two.)

options.text: Provisioning checklist and tasks necessary for setup
Fixed timeline of activities that need to be completed
List of tasks to be executed
Automatic configuration of case form and portal content

questions.explanation: Guided Setup provides A=a provisioning checklist with tasks necessary for setup, and C=a list of tasks to execute. Fixed timelines and automatic configuration are not Guided Setup features.

questions.stem: In the base instance, cases are automatically closed after how many days?

options.text: Cases are not automatically closed by default

questions.explanation: The Auto Close Resolved Cases flow is NOT enabled by default — admins must explicitly activate it. When enabled, defaults are: reminder at 5 days, auto-close at 10 days.

questions.stem: Which table stores consumer addresses?
questions.explanation: Consumer addresses are stored in the standard platform Location table (cmn_location). cmn_location_type stores address type labels (Billing, Shipping) not the address records themselves.

questions.stem: Who can manage Install Base entities? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A=admin and B=sn_customerservice_manager can manage Install Base entities. Data analysts and sales managers do not have Install Base management permissions in CSM.

questions.stem: What does a red highlight on a Case's Action status field indicate?

options.text: The SLA is nearly breached on the Case
The Case is blocked by other tasks or waiting for customer feedback
The case has been escalated and the priority increased
The case needs attention or is waiting for input / review

questions.explanation: A red indicator means the case is blocked — it has open blocking tasks (related case tasks, problem, change) or is waiting for customer feedback. Blue = needs attention; red = blocked.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of a Case Task?

options.text: Case tasks are only used only for Cases that have a Service Definition
Case tasks document customer information on a Case
Case tasks are used to assign work to the customer
Case tasks document additional work that needs to be completed to resolve the Case

questions.explanation: Case tasks document additional work that needs to be completed to resolve the case. They are created and assigned to users who perform the work required for resolution.

questions.stem: Where should non-configurable attributes be stored?
questions.explanation: Non-configurable attributes (fixed product characteristics) should be stored in Product Model tables (cmdb_model and its extensions), not in case or contract tables.

questions.stem: What feature allows an agent to provide updates to customers and internal stakeholders while a Case is in progress?
questions.explanation: Case Action Summaries provide periodic updates to customers and internal stakeholders while a case is in progress. Post Case Reviews (A) summarise after case closure.

questions.stem: What actions should be prioritized when storing Product Models with similar non-configurable attributes? (Choose two.)

options.text: Group them in a baseline table
Create separate tables for each attribute
Modify each product's data model individually
Ensure attributes match those of existing tables

questions.explanation: When product models share similar non-configurable attributes, best practice is A=group them in a baseline table and E=ensure attributes match existing table definitions, avoiding unnecessary separate tables.

questions.stem: Which business model involves supporting an organization's private customers and their employees?
questions.explanation: B2B2C supports an organisation serving its business clients, those clients private end consumers, and optionally their employees — covering both private customers and their associated users.

questions.stem: What does it mean if you do not see the Selector when creating Case tasks?

options.text: No service-to-service relationship has been defined
No Case to case task relationship has been defined
No product to case task relationship has been defined
No customer to task relationship has been defined

questions.explanation: The Selector does not appear when creating case tasks if no service-to-service relationship has been defined. Service definitions enable the task type selector.

questions.stem: For an implementation supporting a business and its customers, which business model should be used?
questions.explanation: B2B2C is the model for an implementation supporting both a business client (B2B) and that client's own end customers or consumers (B2C), covering a multi-level service relationship.

questions.stem: What role do customer data models play in Service CSM from a technical perspective?

options.text: They support the implementation of various business models
They facilitate integration with third-party systems
They define the pricing structure for services

questions.explanation: Customer data models (B2B, B2C, B2B2C, B2B2E) play a technical role by defining how different business relationships are structured and supported within CSM.

questions.stem: Which business models serve an organization's private customers or workers for personal use? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: B=B2B2E serves a business's employees for personal/workplace support; D=B2B2C serves a business's private end consumers. Both models focus on serving individuals through a business intermediary.

questions.stem: When an agent requires additional information from the customer to help solve the case, the case state is:
questions.explanation: When an agent requires additional information from the customer, the agent clicks Request Info, changing the case state from Open to Awaiting Info.

questions.stem: What does the case action status use to automatically determine the action status for Cases?
questions.explanation: Case action status is automatically determined by case flows. Specific agent actions trigger case flows that create and resolve blocking tasks, which in turn set the action status.

questions.stem: How can customer service agents and managers manually set the Action status field for a Case?

options.text: Enable the Needs attention field on the Case form
Change the State to awaiting action

questions.explanation: Customer service agents and managers can manually set the action status for cases by enabling the Needs Attention field on the Case form, without relying on automated flow triggers.

questions.stem: What are the types of units used in counting for entitlements in ServiceNow?
questions.explanation: Entitlements use exactly two unit types for counting: Cases (incident-based) and Hours (time-based). No other unit types are supported OOTB.

questions.stem: How are consumers related to households?

options.text: Household field on the Consumer record
Consumers are not related to Households

questions.explanation: Consumers are related to households via the Household field on the Consumer record. A household groups multiple consumers and designates a head of household.

questions.stem: Why would a customer service manager system administrator create want tabs on a dashboard?

options.text: Reports must be categorized by role on each dashboard
To better organize reports and widgets, and make it easier to share widgets
Reports must be categorized by type on each dashboard
There's a finite number of widgets allowed per dashboard

questions.explanation: Dashboard tabs are used to better organise reports and widgets into logical groupings, making dashboards easier to navigate and widgets easier to share with different audiences.

questions.stem: What action to be taken if the product has no configurable attributes?

options.text: Optimize data in the Install Base Item table
Create new child table for Install Base Item
Group into existing extended Install Base Item table
Store it in the baseline Install Base Item table

questions.explanation: If a product has no configurable attributes, it should be stored directly in the baseline Install Base Item table (sn_install_base_item). No custom extension table is needed when there are no product-specific attributes.

questions.stem: Which data model should be employed to track a household where group of consumers share a common address?
questions.explanation: The Household with Consumer data model is used to track a group of consumers sharing a common address. Households represent a family or other group living at the same location.

questions.stem: Which service catalogs are available in the base instance customer portals? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Two OOTB service catalogs exist in the base instance: A=Consumer Service Catalog (for B2C/Consumer Service Portal) and B=Customer Service Catalog (for B2B/Customer Service Portal). Partner and Product catalogs are not OOTB.

questions.stem: What is included in an account relationship record? (Choose three.)

options.text: The account relationship type that this relationship record is based on

questions.explanation: An account relationship record includes: C=the account relationship type, D=a target account (Account To field), and E=a source account (Account From field). Primary contact and parent/child hierarchy are separate constructs.

questions.stem: What attribute/field is employed to construct the hierarchy of Install Base Items in a system?
questions.explanation: The Parent Install Base Item field constructs the hierarchy of Install Base Items, linking child items to their parent to represent nested product/service configurations.

questions.stem: What should be done if an attribute about an Install Base item is merely for informational purposes?

options.text: Include it in the entitlement details
Track it as an Install Base characteristic
Document it in the product manual
Create an Install Base custom field

questions.explanation: For attributes that are informational only (non-configurable), these should be tracked as Install Base Characteristics — a feature specifically designed to capture and display descriptive attributes of install base items.
